exec: Finland's NCSC says reported data breaches rose significantly in October compared with September, most of them on WordPress sites.
plain: Finland's cyber agency says reported data breaches rose significantly in October compared with September. Most affected WordPress websites, and compromised sites were used to spread malware.

key_findings: Reported data breaches rose significantly compared with September, and most affected WordPress websites.
Compromised sites were used to spread malware via the ClickFix technique.
Major international incidents included vulnerabilities in the PHP programming language and attacks on remote control systems for refrigeration equipment in Europe.

summary: NCSC Finland's Cyber Weather report for October 2026 describes a worrying month. It says reported data breaches rose significantly compared with September, most of them affecting WordPress websites, and that compromised sites were used to spread malware via the ClickFix technique. It also names PHP vulnerabilities and attacks on remote control systems for refrigeration equipment in Europe among major international incidents.
title: NCSC Finland's October Cyber Weather: data breach reports up on September, mostly WordPress sites
